_readme: Glass, frame extras, brand talking points, warranty, and process. Edit the wording here. price.type = 'perWindow' (flat $ per window), 'percent' (% of that window's base price, before other options), 'perSqFt' ($ per square foot of glass), or 'included'. Glass choices are Laminated, Tempered, and Obscured. Each selected glass option adds its percent of the window price, and they stack (two selections = 24%). The obscured pattern is chosen on the Obscure glass screen and does not add a second charge. price.unset true means the add-on price is not known — the screen says 'Price not set' instead of 'Included'. placeholder:true shows a placeholder badge (Settings can hide badges). Do not add ProVia. Do not name the Milgard fiberglass line C650 or C700 (the site uses both). Do not list IWC color names (the site pages disagree). Do not put financing or the SRP rebate in this file. Promo codes live in data/promos.json.

glass.name: Laminated glass
glass.desc: A bonded inner layer for noise, security, and extra UV control near a busy road. Adds 12% of the window price. Stacks with tempered and obscured glass.

glass.name: Tempered (safety) glass
glass.desc: Safety glass that breaks into small pieces. Required when glass faces a tub or shower and the bottom edge is under 60 inches above the floor, unless the glass is more than 60 inches horizontally from the water. Adds 12% of the window price. Stacks with laminated and obscured glass.

glass.name: Obscured glass
glass.desc: Textured or frosted glass that lets light in and blocks the view. Adds 12% of the window price. Pick the pattern on Obscure glass — the pattern does not add a second charge. Andersen patterns have photos. Milgard patterns are listed by name. Stacks with laminated and tempered glass.

frame.name: Grids (Colonial)
frame.desc: Decorative divided-lite grid pattern between the glass for a traditional look.

frame.name: Grids (Prairie)
frame.desc: Prairie-style grid pattern around the perimeter of the sash.

frame.name: Retrofit install
frame.desc: The new window sets into the existing frame, which stays in the wall. No stucco cut. Glass area is slightly smaller. The usual choice on sound stucco homes. See Frame types for retrofit versus full frame.

brands.name: Milgard
brands.note: A Western manufacturer built for hot, dry, high-UV markets. Vinyl lines are named with a V code.

lines.name: Tuscany Series, V400
bullets: The vinyl line Noble quotes most for whole-home replacements
Widest range of sizes, shapes, and hardware
Made in replacement and new-construction configurations

lines.name: Trinsic Series, V300
bullets: The contemporary line
Narrowest frames in Milgard's vinyl range
More glass and view in the same opening

lines.name: Style Line Series, V250
bullets: Flush-fit value line
Single hung, horizontal slider, casement, awning, picture, and radius
For a straightforward like-for-like replacement

lines.name: Ultra Series fiberglass
bullets: Upgrade for west and south elevations
Fiberglass expands at close to the same rate as glass
Holds dark exterior colors better than vinyl

lines.name: A250 aluminum
bullets: Strongest, slimmest Milgard frames
A thermal break is required

brands.name: Andersen
brands.note: Authorized Andersen dealer (not Renewal by Andersen). Quotes 100 Series through E-Series, plus big doors and entry doors.

lines.name: 100 Series
bullets: Fibrex: reclaimed wood fiber bound in thermoplastic
The series quoted most often for whole-home Phoenix replacements
Moves less in heat than standard vinyl and holds dark exterior colors
Narrower frame than vinyl for the same opening
Not a wood interior

lines.name: 200 Series
bullets: Pine interior, Perma-Shield vinyl exterior
Shorter list of sizes

lines.name: 400 Series
bullets: Wood core, Perma-Shield exterior
Full glass menu and more sizes and shapes

lines.name: A-Series
bullets: Architectural Collection
Solid wood interior, Fibrex exterior

lines.name: E-Series
bullets: Wood interior, extruded aluminum exterior
Built to order

lines.name: Low-E4 SmartSun
bullets: The Andersen glass to ask for in Phoenix
About 95% of UV blocked on Andersen's published figures
Low-E4 Sun is the tinted glass for severe west sun only
PassiveSun is for cold climates, not Phoenix

brands.name: IWC
brands.note: Residential aluminum. Color names are left off because the site pages do not agree.

lines.name: 8800 Series Ambassador
bullets: The aluminum window installed in most homes
ThermoTech frames are fully thermally broken
Low-E glass is standard
The frame can be one color outside and another inside
Lifetime limited warranty for the original single-family homeowner while they own the home

warranty.title: 3-Year Workmanship Warranty
warranty.text: Covers the installation. If something we did is the reason a unit leaks, sticks, or will not seal, we come back and correct it. The product warranty comes from the manufacturer and depends on the series.

process.title: Consultation
process.desc: Talk through the house, the sun, and what should change.

process.title: Sun and wall review
process.desc: Which openings take the heat, and whether the frame in the wall can stay.

process.title: Free in-home measure
process.desc: Every opening is measured. Retrofit or full frame is decided here. The visit is usually about an hour.

process.title: Written quote
process.desc: Product, glass package, scope, and one price. Whole-unit U-factor and SHGC when the manufacturer publishes them.

process.title: Order
process.desc: Units are made to the measured sizes. This usually takes a few weeks.

process.title: Installation and walkthrough
process.desc: One opening at a time. Cleanup, then every window is opened and closed with you before sign-off.

seriesNote: Talking points are short versions of noblewindowsanddoors.com. Edit them in data/options.json. Financing offers and rebate claims are not in the app. Promo codes live in data/promos.json.
